20082.long_desc:
Multi Coin Selector model HI-11UCSG, top loading / Drop Type. The coin selector supports 8 channels allowing it to accept 8 kinds of coins at the same time. It is self-programming without a PC and also features an inhibit line for main machine/game board. Made in Taiwan by Weiya.  Accepts coin size diameter 18mm-30mm, and thickness 1.2mm ~ 3.0mm (adjustable 4 kinds of coin thickness).

Suitable for a range of machines and applications including vending machines, and amusement machines.

Please advise currency needed at time of order.

20082.key_features:
- Supports 8 channels (coins) self-programming without PC
- With an inhibit wire for game board
- With 6 channel parallel output for each channel (coin) control
- Support one coin then multi pulse output (impulse out ratio)
- With narrow or wide impulse width select (100ms and 50ms)
- Adjustable 4 kinds of coin thickness
- setup for use with australian coins
